content:
My confidence in my answers can vary depending on the context and the information available to me. For factual questions, especially those grounded in widely accepted knowledge, I tend to be quite confident. However, for more subjective or nuanced questions, my confidence may be lower, and I will often provide caveats or alternative perspectives.

I always strive to provide the most accurate and helpful information based on the data and knowledge I have been trained on. If you have specific concerns or need more detailed reasoning, feel free to ask!
